symptom: for five minutes storefront's payment calls failed (no endpoints behind the Service); before and after, every call succeeds

path.note: scaled to 0 replicas, back to 1 five minutes later

decoys.why: where the errors were logged; it never changed

variants_note: At 360 s the fault has just been undone and its events are still in the cluster. At 4200 s (70 min) both scale events have passed the default 1 h event TTL; what remains is storefront's error lines in Loki, kube-state-metrics' replica series in Prometheus (2 h retention on dev), the payments pod's age and the Deployment's managedFields time for the scale subresource.
